title: FDA approves Hibsago (bepirovirsen) to treat chronic hepatitis B virus infection in certain adults without cirrhosis, in combination with existing antiviral therapy
summary: Novel drug approval of 10/20/2026: Hibsago (bepirovirsen) to treat chronic hepatitis B virus infection in certain adults without cirrhosis, in combination with existing antiviral therapy.

title: FDA approves Hovilpri (pritelivir) to treat adults with weakened immune systems who have mucocutaneous lesions caused by herpes simplex virus infection and have not responded to other therapies
summary: Novel drug approval of 10/9/2026: Hovilpri (pritelivir) to treat adults with weakened immune systems who have mucocutaneous lesions caused by herpes simplex virus infection and have not responded to other therapies.
